annotations.title: Move a Tracker entry to a stage

description: Move one Tracker entry to a new stage (for example rejected or interview), as if the user dragged the card on the /tracker board, with the same history, undo and conflict checks. Pass exactly one of applicationId or jobId. This is separate from trackly_update_status, which only sets the job list status: marking an entry rejected here keeps its Applied record and does not discard the job. There is no "paused" stage: record a pause with trackly_add_tracker_note and leave the stage unchanged. If the entry is already in that stage nothing is written. Returns not_found when the job has no Tracker entry yet (this tool never creates one; use trackly_create_tracker_application first), tracker_unavailable when the Tracker is switched off, and version_conflict with the entry's current version and stage if it kept changing; nothing is written on any error.

applicationId.description: Tracker entry ID from trackly_list_tracker_applications. Pass exactly one of applicationId or jobId.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

jobId.description: Trackly job posting ID. Resolved to its Tracker entry. Pass exactly one of applicationId or jobId.

note.description: Optional dated note saved after the stage change, up to 1000 characters. Say where the evidence came from, for example "rejection email, Nov 9".

occurredOn.description: Calendar date the change happened, YYYY-MM-DD, read as a local date in America/Los_Angeles. Omit to use the time of the call.

stage.description: New Tracker stage. One of: contacted, saved, applied, screen, assessment, interview, final, offer, accepted, declined, rejected, withdrawn

name: trackly_update_tracker_stage
